caption: The drawing features an aerial view of a garden layout with various distinct areas and objects. Predominantly green in color, the garden is composed of multiple landscaped sections, including neatly arranged paths in pale yellow that wind through the space, surrounded by green lawn, clusters of shrubs, and trees of differing sizes. In the lower-left corner, there is a large circular fountain with light blue water and a tall sculpture of a bird in the center, from which water is spouting upwards. The central area of the garden has a circular feature with a smaller fountain or statue in the middle, encircled by patterned planting beds, neatly trimmed hedges, and further divided into symmetrical, ornamental sections. The upper part of the garden includes an elongated, enclosed area with plotted pink flowering plants along its border and a grid-like pattern inside, likely representing planting beds or trellis structures. To the right of the fountain and central garden, there is a rectangular structure with a faintly lined roof, resembling a greenhouse or glasshouse. Dense trees and taller shrubs border the garden in several areas, and the entire layout is surrounded by soft green grass and assorted foliage. The bottom edge of the drawing is labeled with the names "The L.P. Martin Garden" and "The Blackwell Survey."
title: Isaace P. Martin Garden
